name: AI Alliance
learn: Project leaders, contribution provenance and separate project governance.
implementation: Project intake, DCO/IP register, named owner and explicit support relationship.
licence: Published governance; page reuse terms must be checked. Its managed-project code/data/docs licences differ.
limit: Do not conflate project participation with membership, endorsement or execution authority.

name: Alliance for AI Transformation and Innovation
learn: Participation by women and communities of color, education and workforce inclusion.
implementation: Affected-user recruitment, assisted participation and published representation gaps.
licence: No reusable software stack or licence verified in the pages inspected.
limit: Distinct organisation from the AI Alliance and Open Secure AI Alliance; identity is not assumed from the shared name.

name: Open Secure AI Alliance
learn: Scoped proposals, leadership from different organisations, rosters, meeting records and charter amendments.
implementation: Add group terms, vacancies, decision route, dissent, annual review and closure.
licence: CC-BY-4.0 governance repository; retain attribution for adapted material.
limit: Local Council procedures are proposals; OSAA membership and voting rules do not automatically apply here.

name: SAFE working group
learn: Separate approved working-group existence from the charter document's publication status.
implementation: Keep SAFE profile/evidence mappings versioned and field-level.
licence: Repository reports CC-BY-4.0; exact charter remains a short under-development notice.
limit: The inspected CHARTER.md still says under development; do not fabricate charter clauses.

name: IETF working-group GitHub guidance
learn: Versioned proposals, issues, published drafts, broad review and explicit consensus.
implementation: Datatracker states and a decision record separate from forum popularity; back up discussions.
licence: IETF document terms; do not relicense the RFC as CC0.
limit: A GitHub merge, reaction count or active chat is not consensus or independent approval.

name: IETF Datatracker
learn: Document revisions, milestones, chairs and lifecycle tracking.
implementation: Use its lifecycle as a design reference; trial a full deployment only if existing workflow cannot serve the need.
licence: BSD-3-Clause; preserve licence and notices. Python/Django/PostgreSQL application.
limit: A full fork carries substantial IETF-specific processes and maintenance.

name: Discourse
implementation: Preferred forum integration candidate when moderators, sign-in, privacy and backups are staffed.
limit: Forum posts are discussion, never effect authorisation. Prototype B is not a deployed Discourse instance.

name: Decidim
implementation: Alternative for formal public consultation after demand is demonstrated.
licence: AGPL-3.0 repository; review exact distribution/network-use obligations before deployment.
limit: Heavier participation platform; no installation or representative public trial in this batch.

name: NIST OSCAL
implementation: Map source controls into explicit applicability profiles and evidence requirements.
licence: Use published schemas; check exact artefact terms before redistribution.
limit: This register is not OSCAL schema-valid yet; no NIST compliance claim.

name: NIST AI RMF
implementation: Keep a separate framework entry, version and scope-specific mapping.
licence: Official NIST publication; verify individual source reuse terms.
limit: Existing axis pointers are not a clause-level implementation or universal legal duty.

name: US SEC rulemaking sources
learn: Distinguish proposals, final rules and effective versions.
implementation: Route exact instruments by jurisdiction, entity role, activity and effective dates to qualified review.
licence: Official source register; no blanket reuse or applicability finding.
limit: SEC is an authority, not one charter or one regulation; instrument-specific mappings remain open.

name: MLCommons Croissant
learn: Dataset metadata for discovery and reproducible loading.
implementation: Generate dataset descriptors for qualified public evidence exports to HF/Kaggle.
licence: Implementation/examples Apache-2.0; specification CC-BY-ND-4.0 with published linking/adaptation guidance.
limit: Metadata neither certifies results nor clears data rights; do not copy and relicense the specification as CC0.

name: NVIDIA OpenShell
learn: Sandbox, network policy and credential isolation.
implementation: Reuse the existing adapter; bind admitted arguments, effective policy, attempts and effects.
licence: Apache-2.0 repository; exact release and dependencies must be pinned.
limit: Historical bounded canary exists; current full-system qualification and provider authority remain separate.

name: OpenBMC
learn: Physical server management firmware and Redfish/IPMI interfaces.
implementation: Retain read-only hardware evidence adapter; hardware changes need separate authorisation.
licence: Multi-component firmware tree; inspect per-component licences.
limit: Existing evidence is fixture-only. It is not Mac control software or the governance portal.

name: Linux Foundation LFX PCC
learn: Project onboarding, roles and collaboration setup for associated LF projects.
implementation: Check actual project eligibility and access before planning hosted LFX functions.
licence: Hosted service access/terms; no self-hostable full PCC entitlement verified.
limit: LF membership alone is not proof that every tool or hosting service is available.

name: W3C WCAG 2.2
learn: Accessibility criteria for perceivable and operable interfaces.
implementation: Target WCAG 2.2 AA; add keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, zoom and affected-user testing.
licence: W3C document licence; preserve attribution and authoritative version.
limit: Automated browser checks are partial; no all-demographics or WCAG-conformance claim.
